task.description: Actionable work that someone intends or needs to complete. Use for chores, errands, reminders, follow-ups, purchases, submissions, calls, and other concrete to-dos. A due date is a deadline, not a scheduled time block. Do not use for an event merely because it has a date, or for a future aspiration with no concrete commitment. Examples: 明天交电费；提醒我买牛奶；周五前提交报告。

name.title: Name
name.description: The concrete action or to-do to complete.

description.title: Description
description.description: Supporting details about how or why to complete the task.

dueDate.title: Due Date
dueDate.description: The deadline date for completing the task, not a calendar time block.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current lifecycle state of the task.

assigneePersonIds.title: Assignees
assigneePersonIds.description: People responsible for completing the task.

completedAt.title: Completed At
completedAt.description: When the task was completed, set by the authoritative completion Action.

completedByType.title: Completed By Type
completedByType.description: Type of Actor that completed the task, set by the authoritative completion Action.

completedById.title: Completed By
completedById.description: Identifier of the Actor that completed the task, set by the authoritative completion Action.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Business subject of the work: a Space Person or native Record.

recurrenceOccurrenceId.title: Recurrence Occurrence
recurrenceOccurrenceId.description: Platform-owned stable occurrence identity for generated tasks.

guards.message: Only generated Tasks have a recurrence occurrence

wish.description: An aspiration, desire, or hoped-for future experience or thing that the user wants but has not committed to as a concrete task or scheduled event. Use for bucket-list items, dreams, desired purchases, and hoped-for experiences. Never use Wish as a fallback merely because its schema is broad or another model has missing fields. Examples: 想去冰岛看极光；希望以后有一台房车；想学会潜水。

title.title: Title
title.description: A concise statement of the aspiration or desired outcome.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional detail about the aspiration and why it is desired.

desiredDate.title: Desired Date
desiredDate.description: A hoped-for date, not a committed task deadline or scheduled event time.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the wish is still waiting to happen or has been fulfilled.

ownerPersonId.title: Owner
ownerPersonId.description: The person whose aspiration this is.

fulfilledAt.title: Fulfilled At
fulfilledAt.description: When the wish was marked fulfilled.

guards.message: Only open wishes can be fulfilled
Only fulfilled wishes can be reopened

day_record.description: A date-anchored tracker for counting elapsed days, counting down to a date, or representing a recurring/cycle interval. Use for since/until counters, milestones anchored to a date, streaks, and cycle tracking. Do not use for ordinary appointments, one-off calendar occurrences, or concrete to-dos. Examples: 从今天开始戒糖；距离生日还有多少天；每28天一个周期。

name.title: Name
name.description: The milestone, streak, countdown, or cycle being tracked.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional context about the tracked date or cycle.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Tracker mode: elapsed since anchorDate, countdown until anchorDate, or recurring cycle.

anchorDate.title: Anchor Date
anchorDate.description: The calendar date that anchors the elapsed, countdown, or cycle calculation.

subjectPersonId.title: Subject
subjectPersonId.description: Optional person the tracked date or cycle belongs to.

attentionAfterDays.title: Attention After Days
attentionAfterDays.description: Number of days after the anchor date when the record should enter an attention window.

attentionBeforeDays.title: Attention Before Days
attentionBeforeDays.description: Number of days before the anchor date when the record should enter an attention window.

cycleDays.title: Cycle Days
cycleDays.description: Length in days for a recurring cycle.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current lifecycle state of the day record.

event.description: A calendar occurrence that happens or is planned for a specific date or time and may occupy time or involve attendance or a location. Use for meetings, appointments, classes, matches, meals, celebrations, and other things that occur. Do not use merely because a task has a deadline. Examples: 周六上午十点足球比赛；明晚七点和王老师吃饭；8月30日体检。

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A concise name for the calendar occurrence.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the occurrence happens, when explicitly provided.

when.title: When
when.description: When the occurrence happens. Use the date variant for all-day/date-only events and the instant variant for timed events.

attendeePersonIds.title: Attendees
attendeePersonIds.description: People attending or participating in the occurrence.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current lifecycle state of the event.

person_group.description: A durable named grouping of Space People used to refer to a set of people together, such as family, classmates, teammates, colleagues, or another user-defined circle. Membership expresses grouping only and does not imply authority or a typed interpersonal relationship.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of the group or circle.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional context describing what the group represents.

memberPersonIds.title: Members
memberPersonIds.description: Space People included in this group.

anniversary.description: A date that commemorates a meaningful occasion each year, with or without a known original year. Use for birthdays, wedding anniversaries, and personal milestones. Do not use for a planned celebration or appointment; use Event instead. Examples: 爸妈结婚纪念日（10月8日）；小朋友生日（3月12日）。

name.title: Name
name.description: The occasion being remembered, such as a wedding anniversary, birthday, or first day of school.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional background about the occasion and why it matters to the people involved.

personIds.title: People
personIds.description: People connected to the occasion; may include several people, such as both partners in a wedding anniversary.

month.title: Month
month.description: Month in which the anniversary falls each year (1–12), whether or not its original year is known.

day.title: Day
day.description: Day of the anniversary within its month; use a real calendar day for the chosen month.

year.title: Original Year
year.description: Original year of the occasion when known; omit it for anniversaries known only by month and day.

activity.description: A purposeful activity or undertaking that may extend over several days and involve multiple people or plans. Use for trips, camps, competitions, and other shared endeavors. Do not use for a single appointment (Event) or a desired result (Goal). Examples: 国庆家庭旅行；秋季校园足球联赛。

name.title: Name
name.description: The name by which people recognize the activity, such as a trip, training camp, or football competition.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional purpose, plans, or context that explains what this activity involves.

attendeePersonIds.title: Attendees
attendeePersonIds.description: People who take part in or are associated with the activity; an activity may have no named participants.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: First calendar date of the activity, if a start date is known.

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: Last calendar date of the activity, if an end date is known.

goal.description: An outcome that one or more people intend to achieve, with optional starting and target dates. Use for learning, health, family, or personal aspirations. Do not use for a single action (Task) or something scheduled to occur (Event). Examples: 年内通过钢琴五级；每年读完二十本书。

name.title: Name
name.description: The outcome being sought, stated as something people want to accomplish.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional motivation, success criteria, or context explaining what achieving the goal means.

subjectPersonIds.title: People
subjectPersonIds.description: People pursuing or sharing the goal; this may be an individual or several family members.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: Calendar date when pursuit of the goal begins, if known.

targetDate.title: Target Date
targetDate.description: Desired date by which the goal should be achieved; it is not an appointment or scheduled event.

status.title: Status
status.description: The current lifecycle state of the goal, controlled by explicit actions rather than ordinary updates.

person_profile.description: A personal attribute, preference, or background fact that helps describe a known person. Use for details such as education, interests, sizes, or preferences. Do not use for identity and access, dated experiences, or diary entries. Examples: 毕业学校=北京大学；喜欢的运动=足球。

personId.title: Person
personId.description: The person whom this attribute or background fact describes.

key.title: Key
key.description: Name of the attribute or fact, such as 毕业学校, 服装尺码, or 喜欢的运动.

value.title: Value
value.description: The person's value or explanation for this attribute, such as 北京大学, M, or 足球.

habit.description: A repeated behavior someone intends to maintain through actual check-ins over time. Use for practices such as reading, exercise, or music practice when ongoing consistency matters. Do not use for a one-off Task, a scheduled Event, an elapsed-day counter (DayRecord), or a desired outcome (Goal). Examples: 每天读书30分钟；至少每两天运动一次。

name.title: Name
name.description: The behavior or practice a person intends to maintain over time, such as reading for 30 minutes or practicing piano.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional context, instructions, or motivation that explains what practicing the habit involves.

intervalDays.title: Check-in Interval (days)
intervalDays.description: The maximum allowed calendar-day gap between two check-ins without interrupting the streak. Use 1 for daily check-ins, or 2 when up to two calendar days may pass between them. This choice is fixed after creation.

lastCheckInDate.title: Last Check-in Date
lastCheckInDate.description: The latest calendar date on which this habit was checked in. Empty before the first check-in; dates follow the Space's local calendar.

streakStartDate.title: Streak Start Date
streakStartDate.description: The first check-in date of the most recently recorded uninterrupted sequence. When the allowed gap is exceeded, the next check-in begins a new sequence.

subjectPersonId.title: Practicing Person
subjectPersonId.description: The one Space Person responsible for this habit and its check-ins, fixed when the habit is created.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state of this practice; only active habits may record check-ins.
